messages:
Alex: Morning triage — quick async check-in. Current numbers: 42 open tickets, 7 P1s (2 awaiting customer). Known issues: embed-generation duplicate-response bug was mitigated last night but a handful of customers still see duplicates. Workaround applied server-side for affected accounts.

Alex: What I did yesterday: cleared a backlog of long-tail account follow-ups and pushed macro updates to /reply-ack and /escalate. Blockers: still waiting on infra patch for tokenization edge-case (blocks a small percentage of uploads) — infra estimates ETA today afternoon. Today: pair with eng-infra on verification, run macro QA across top flows, triage the 7 P1s. Ping me for quick reviews on PR #402.

Maria: Thanks. Volume here matches — saw 3 new cases from retailer-X overnight, two look like duplicate embeddings. Using /reply-ack for initial responses. I'll do macro QA after lunch. No blockers from my side. :thumbsup:

Chen: Reviewed PR #402, left one comment about template escaping when customer name contains commas. Small fix. Happy to re-review after the patch. I can run tokenization verification once infra posts the patch.

Jamal: I'll take ownership of the two customer-waiting P1s (IDs: P1-1789, P1-1791). Asked for logs from customer A at 09:12 — awaiting reply. If no log in 1hr I'll escalate to oncall.

support-bot: Automated note: created internal follow-up task T-4621 for embed duplicates, linked to tickets 9043, 9047.

Alex: Updated macros snippet (live):
```
/reply-ack -> Hi {customer_name}, thanks for reporting this. We're investigating and will update within 4 hours. If you can share logs, please paste them here or use the secure upload link. — Support
/escalate -> Escalating this issue to oncall: {issue_link}. Priority: P1. Noted impact: {short_description}.
```

Maria: Quick QA note — when using /reply-ack the placeholder {customer_name} isn't populated for some webchat tickets. Filing a short bug for macro-rendering.

Chen: Thanks, I'll add a unit test for macro rendering edge cases (commas, emojis).

Jamal: If infra patch is delayed > 3h I suggest temporary rollback of the new tokenizer on affected region. Agree?

Alex: Agreed. If infra confirms >3h delay, rollback plan activated and I'll open rollback PR.

Maria: Marking this thread as primary triage source for the morning. I'll update counts at 11:30 with any changes.

Alex: Cool — add any quick FYIs below. Otherwise we'll reconvene at the 11:30 snapshot. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
